description: Formal session-level partition catalog enforcing zero-leakage research governance

train.description: Sessions strictly reserved for fitting model parameters and feature normalizers

validation.description: Sessions strictly reserved for model selection, hyperparameter tuning, and threshold calibration

calibration.description: Ambient empty room reference baseline samples captured prior to deployment

test.description: Untouched physical holdout sessions strictly evaluated post-training (ZERO TOUCH RULE)
test.policy: No synthetic data permitted. Pipeline halts with exit code 1 until physical session is captured.
